name: veteran-engineering-studio
description: End-to-end software engineering plus specialist frontend product design in one plugin: repository takeover, architecture, debugging, backend, data, release and operations, paired with high-fidelity UI/UX design, design-system reuse, implementation, responsive polish, and rendered visual QA.

interface.shortDescription: Full-stack engineering with specialist frontend design and visual QA
interface.longDescription: A two-skill engineering plugin. Veteran Full-Stack Engineer owns substantial software work end to end across architecture, frontend, backend, data, debugging, migrations, release and operations. Frontend Design Builder specializes in visual direction, design systems, design-to-code, responsive interaction, motion and rendered visual fidelity. The skills route work between each other without collapsing into one oversized prompt.
defaultPrompt: Take ownership of this software task end to end, using the frontend design specialist whenever visual UI quality or design-system work is material.
Audit this product across engineering and UI quality, implement the highest-value fixes, and verify the real runtime result.
Build this feature as a production-quality vertical slice, including polished frontend behavior and rendered QA when applicable.
